observations.text: Reassessment round scope and byte state. argv "git rev-parse HEAD" prints fae9fe07d0e6e733d85d63dd9fac736c91b01e9f, exit 0; argv "git status --porcelain" prints nothing, exit 0, so every byte judged in this round is the committed byte of fae9fe0. argv "git diff --stat d63a173 HEAD", exit 0: 6 files, 171 insertions, 41 deletions - five production files under crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/ (handlers/instance.rs, handlers/secrets_key.rs, secrets_key_rotation.rs, store_capabilities.rs, worker.rs) plus docs/feature/iis-secrets-key-replace/runs/craft.S3.json. argv "git diff --name-only d63a173 HEAD -- crates/foundry-acceptance docs/feature/iis-secrets-key-replace/handoff.json docs/feature/iis-secrets-key-replace/architecture.md docs/product/architecture" piped to wc -l prints 0, exit 0: the delta touches no oracle path, no acceptance support, no handoff, no ADR and no architecture text. The immutable oracle is preserved, so every unaffected judgment of the accepted record at b61593f is retained and only the two recorded implementation findings are reassessed.

Touched-file test selection for this round, mechanical and not memory-picked, with the project port tool recorded as unusable again. argv "timeout -k 5 120 code-fact impacted-tests crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/instance.rs crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/secrets_key.rs crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/store_capabilities.rs crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/worker.rs" exited 124, killed at its 120 s bound, with 0 bytes on stdout and 0 bytes on stderr: no selection result at all, recorded as unusable tooling and not as an empty impact set. Mechanical git fallback over the five changed production files: the foundry-app library unit tests of module integrations:: (they hold the rotation table test the delta extends and the two in-file test doubles it edits), the us-iis-07 acceptance lane (the only driving oracle of the changed handlers), and the workspace fmt, clippy and check-arch gates. crates/foundry-store and its tests are untouched by this delta. Both selected sets were run: the reused smoke result and the lane run recorded below.

Reused native result, cited with its operator and run, inputs unchanged. The host executed argv "timeout -k 30 3000 scripts/test-in-lima.sh bash -c \"mkdir -p ~/.cache/rustc-tmp && TMPDIR=$HOME/.cache/rustc-tmp CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo xtask smoke\"" on a tree byte-identical to fae9fe0; it exited 0 and printed "xtask smoke :: all gates green". Log: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jeffbailey-Projects-canzan-foundry/ae6f0864-8ca5-43d5-b970-fb78c37ae831/scratchpad/smoke-rework2.log. Smoke covers cargo fmt --check, clippy over the workspace and all targets, xtask check-arch (the integrations-seal-fence rule the renamed store helper is listed under) and the workspace test suites, which include the foundry-app library tests of integrations:: with the rotation table test carrying the two assertions this delta adds. I did not re-execute it: source, test, argv and runtime inputs are unchanged, and the reuse waives no check. Smoke excludes crates/foundry-acceptance, so the acceptance lane was the one missing selected check and I executed it myself.

The one missing selected check, executed once by this reviewer on the exact commit under review. argv "timeout -k 30 2700 scripts/test-in-lima.sh bash -c \"mkdir -p ~/.cache/rustc-tmp; export TMPDIR=$HOME/.cache/rustc-tmp CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4; source scripts/eip-lanes.sh; eip_warm; eip_lane us-iis-07\"", run in the Lima VM at fae9fe0 with a clean tree, exit status 0. stdout, last lines: "[Summary]", "1 feature", "29 scenarios (29 passed)", "513 steps (513 passed)"; stderr was merged into the same log and holds the cargo compile lines only; argv "grep -c failed <log>" prints 0. Log: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jeffbailey-Projects-canzan-foundry/ae6f0864-8ca5-43d5-b970-fb78c37ae831/scratchpad/reviewer-lane-us-iis-07.fae9fe0.log. This is the behaviour-preservation evidence of the delta: the same 29 of 29 scenarios and 513 of 513 steps this reviewer observed at b61593f, with the I-28a Confirmation scenarios among them (a trimmed " START OVER " applies; an empty field and "start over" are refused, land back on the cost page and discard nothing) and the live-replica gate scenarios of the I-26 page.

Finding 1 of the accepted record, the absent StartOverConfirmation carrier, is resolved exactly as the consumed design names it. argv "grep -rn StartOverConfirmation|StartOverPlan crates/ xtask/" (an alternation) now prints 19 lines, exit 0, where the same grep for StartOverConfirmation printed nothing and exited 1 at b61593f. secrets_key_rotation.rs:246 declares pub struct StartOverConfirmation(()) with a private unit field, so no module but its own can build it and no caller outside the crate can; its one constructor, typed(field: &str) -> Option<Self> at :255, keeps the shipped rule unchanged (field.trim() == START OVER, the words held as a private constant of the type) and admits nothing else, an empty and an absent field included. The boolean validator is gone: UnopenableOffer::confirms no longer exists, and argv "grep -rn confirms( crates/ xtask/" returns only unrelated acceptance step functions of other features. The evidence reaches the apply: handlers/secrets_key.rs:407-410 binds the value with a let-else that re-answers the cost page on a wrong, empty or absent field, :430 started_over carries it, and store_capabilities.rs:253 InstanceKeyWrites::start_over_secrets_key takes confirmed: StartOverConfirmation as its first parameter, so rustc refuses the apply to a caller holding none (nw-type-level-design write rules 3 and 4; the StoreCapabilities implementation at :524 spends it as _confirmed and forwards nothing, which matches the port doc). architecture.md:1704 and :997-1005 now agree with the bytes (nw-code-craftsmanship rule 39). The sibling StartOverPlan at :266 is inside the consumed design, not an invented element: architecture.md:44 names "ReplacePlan and StartOverPlan over a GeneratePlan"; it reuses plan_generate unchanged, holds two fields, adds no second decider and mirrors the readers ReplacePlan already exposes at :335-345. Claim strength as the checker gives it: construction is centralised in mainstream Rust, not proved; the refusal with its page and the valid build are both observed through the public port by the oracle (feature scenarios at lines 1411-1448), so nw-type-level-design rule 7 is met without a crafter unit test, and none was added.

Finding 2 of the accepted record, the per-render SELECT ... FOR UPDATE over integration_replica_states, is resolved, and its behaviour equivalence is proved over the whole input domain rather than argued. handlers/instance.rs:1385 reads the replica rows only where UnopenableOffer::reads_gate(integrations.key_mode(), integrations.key_file()) is true and passes None otherwise, so in the Sealed, Direct, AwaitingSecretsKey and NoInstanceKey modes, and in Unopenable with a Withheld key file, no row is read and no lock is taken. The predicate and its consumer cannot disagree: facts_of at :772 and :778 builds PageFacts.mode and key_file_read from the same two readers of the same Integrations snapshot that :1385 reads, and page_state:693 is the single consumer of facts.live_opener (argv grep over instance.rs shows exactly two call sites of the gate predicates, :693 and :1385, and two of live_opener, :556 for the start-over door list and :1388 under the guard). The decision stays with the owner of the fact: reads_gate (secrets_key_rotation.rs:215) sits beside decide and follows its table, so no second place states when the gate matters. Equivalence, asserted inside the pre-existing table test the_table_of_the_three_i26_states: for every key file under KeyMode::Unopenable, including both Withheld rows, reads_gate == (decide(.., live, ..) != decide(.., !live, ..)); and over ALL_MODES x ALL_FILES x both gate readings for every other mode, reads_gate is false and of_gate(mode, None, key_file) == decide(mode, live, key_file). Where the read is skipped the page therefore shows the identical words, including the appended live-replica sentence, which stays None in every skipped state. The us-iis-07 lane confirms it at the driving port (29 of 29, R13). No test was weakened: argv "git show d63a173:crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs" shows the unread-gate assertions pre-date the delta; the delta only adds assertions, and adds, renames and removes no test function.

Test-path audit of the delta, design-quality scan of the changed units, and the capability limits of this round. No test path was added or changed beyond the recorded oracle: the delta touches nothing under crates/foundry-acceptance (R10), and inside production files it changes only the two in-file test doubles that implement InstanceKeyWrites (handlers/secrets_key.rs:738-739 and worker.rs:1015-1016), which follow the port signature and assert nothing, plus added assertions in one existing crafter-owned unit test (R15). Nothing is skipped, softened, narrowed, deleted or re-expected to match output, and no testing-theatre pattern appears in the added assertions: each compares a predicate to an independently computed expectation (a flipped gate reading, the unread-gate offer), so a reads_gate that answered true everywhere, or a predicate wired to of_gate, fails them. Design quality over the three changed logical units, judged against nw-code-design-oo and nw-code-craftsmanship: StartOverConfirmation owns one invariant and returns its witness instead of a boolean; StartOverPlan owns what a start over writes, holds two fields and duplicates no rule (plan_generate stays the one generator); reads_gate is pure and total beside the table it follows. Dependency direction, effect separation and the store SQL are untouched, the port doc states the precondition it cannot check, and no element was added that no accepted outcome reads - the spent _confirmed parameter is the type-level obligation itself. typesafe: unavailable - argv "zsh -lc [ -n $TYPESAFE_API_KEY ] test" prints KEY_ABSENT, exit 0, so the service prerequisite is absent from the login environment; no call was made, none is fabricated, and no producer-owned Jev judgment was consumed. Import metadata is unavailable, so the exercised changed product files rest on the two runs of R12 and R13, which exercise all five changed files. No timing measurement was taken: no test is at half budget and no derogation is in force. No agent-listing or peer-messaging capability is exposed to this role, so this outcome travels to the root.

diagnostic: Accepted at fae9fe0, with no remaining and no new finding. Reassessment of the delta d63a173..HEAD only; every judgment of the accepted whole-candidate review at b61593f stands, because the delta touches no oracle path, no acceptance support, no handoff, no ADR and no architecture text (R10), so the immutable oracle is preserved unchanged and its completeness against the original Request needed no re-reading. Both carried implementation findings are resolved and removed. F1: the design-named carrier exists and the apply cannot be reached without it - StartOverConfirmation with a private unit field and typed(field) -> Option<Self> as its only constructor, the boolean UnopenableOffer::confirms deleted, the value carried through started_over into InstanceKeyWrites::start_over_secrets_key, where rustc refuses a caller holding none, and the sibling StartOverPlan is the carrier architecture.md:44 already names, so architecture.md:1704 now agrees with the bytes (R14). F2: the instance page reads the replica rows only where UnopenableOffer::reads_gate says the gate decides a word, the predicate lives beside the decide table it follows, the predicate and its consumer read the same snapshot, and the extended table test asserts over ALL_MODES x ALL_FILES x both gate readings that reads_gate is true exactly where flipping the gate changes the offer and that the unread reading equals the decided offer everywhere else, so the words the admin reads are identical with the read skipped (R15). Evidence: the host smoke run on bytes identical to fae9fe0, exit 0, all gates green, covering fmt, clippy, check-arch and the workspace suites that hold the extended rotation test (R12, reused with its operator and argv, inputs unchanged); my own us-iis-07 lane run at fae9fe0, exit 0, 29 of 29 scenarios and 513 of 513 steps, which is the behaviour-preservation observation and also covers the I-28a Confirmation refusals and the live-replica gate at the public port (R13). No test path was added or changed beyond the recorded oracle; the delta only adds assertions to one existing crafter-owned unit test and follows the port signature in two in-file test doubles, and no assertion was weakened (R16). No testing theatre and no design-quality finding in the three changed units. Limits retained: the project selector code-fact impacted-tests exited 124 at its 120 s bound with empty stdout and stderr, so selection fell back to a mechanical git-based one (R11); typesafe unavailable, TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent, no call made or fabricated and no producer judgment consumed; import metadata unavailable, so exercised changed targets rest on the two runs above; no timing measurement, no test being at half budget and no derogation in force. No peer messaging is exposed to this role, so this outcome travels to the root.
